info.title: ConnectWise Manage/PSA REST API (community reference subset)
info.description: Best-effort OpenAPI 3.0 spec generated from the endpoint listings in jasondsmith72/cwmapi (Company, Service, System, Time modules only). Not an official ConnectWise document -- parameter/body schemas are generic (permissive), not exact. Finance, Project, Sales, Marketing, Procurement, and Schedule modules are NOT included.
